tasks.short: Document quantity, quality, weight, and value on the records.

steps.what: Document quantity, quality, weight, and test result
Compute value from the quantity and the rate card
Maintain the shipping, receiving, and production records
Sign the quantity and value record

outputs: filed copy of signed quantity record v1

tasks.design: The weigher documents quantity, quality, type, weight, and the test result for materials or products. A job in {ERP} computes value from that quantity and the rate card. The weigher maintains the shipping, receiving, and production record, signs it, and a job files that version. The computed value is not the record until it is signed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A value could be written onto a file before anyone had stood at the goods.
tasks.enabler_now: A rate card can turn a signed quantity into a value.
tasks.still_hard: Quality and the test result are still seen on the goods.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher signs the record and remains responsible for it.

ambition.what: File the signed quantity on the same shift the goods are seen.

tasks.altitude: The looking and the signature stay. The multiplication shrinks.

reach.learn: Which rate card the value used

evidence.claim: The records digest says weights and charges are plain code from a rate card.
The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: Configure the rate card before custom code.
unknowns: Who else must sign a high value.
research_questions: How often the rate card is behind the current price.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the document step is the looking itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every lot is still seen by the weigher. The high end assumes only the value arithmetic is no longer done by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Weigh or measure materials, equipment, or products.

steps.what: Weigh or measure materials, equipment, or products
Use volume meters, scales, rules, or calipers
Sign the measurement for the record

outputs: filed copy of signed measurement v1

tasks.design: Weighing and measuring materials, equipment, or products stays with the weigher, using volume meters, scales, rules, or calipers. A job files the measurement in {ERP} only after the weigher signs it. The instrument does not sign.
tasks.previous_blocker: A screen figure could be stored before anyone had used the instrument.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed reading can be filed on the existing record.
tasks.still_hard: The measurement only exists when the weigher takes it.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher takes the measurement and signs it.
tasks.altitude: The measurement stays. Filing the signed reading shrinks.

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not weigh or measure.
research_questions: How often a scale needs a check weight.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the weigh step is the measurement itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every item is still measured by the weigher. The high end assumes only the signed reading is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare measurement labels and attach them to products.

steps.what: Collect or prepare measurement and weight labels
Prepare identification labels for the products
Attach the labels to the products

outputs: filed copy of signed label record v1

tasks.design: The weigher collects or prepares the measurement, weight, and identification labels and attaches them to the products. A job files the label record in {ERP} only after the weigher signs it. A printer may produce the sheet. It does not attach it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A printed label could be treated as attached when it was still on the bench.
tasks.enabler_now: A label sheet can be printed from a signed measurement.
tasks.still_hard: Attaching the label to the right product is still done by hand.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher attaches the label and signs that it is on the product.
tasks.altitude: Attaching stays. Filing the signed label record shrinks.

reach.task: Ship only a product with the signed label

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not attach a label.
Nothing is filed as attached before signature.
unknowns: Which products need an identification label.
research_questions: How often the printed text does not match the goods.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the label step is the attaching itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every label is still attached by the weigher. The high end assumes only the signed label record is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine products and packaging for damage or shortages.

steps.what: Show specification sheets, gauges, and standards charts
Examine products, materials, parts, and subassemblies
Examine packaging for damage, defects, or shortages

outputs: filed copy of signed examination note v1

tasks.design: A job shows the specification sheets, gauges, and standards charts stored in {DOCS}. The weigher examines products, materials, parts, subassemblies, and packaging for damage, defects, or shortages. They sign the note. A job files that version. The chart does not decide.
tasks.previous_blocker: A missing line on a chart could be treated as a defect nobody had seen.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored sheets can be shown beside the work.
tasks.still_hard: Damage and a shortage are still seen on the goods.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher examines the goods and signs what they found.
tasks.altitude: The examination stays. Finding the stored sheet shrinks.

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not examine the goods.
Nothing is filed as a defect before signature.
unknowns: Which standard applies to this product.
research_questions: How often the stored sheet is the wrong revision.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the examination is the looking itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every item is still examined by the weigher. The high end assumes only the stored sheet is no longer hunted by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The weigher spends the shift on the scale, the sample, and the check. A captured quantity can be filed after they sign it. The scale's own readout is not saved human time.
reach: A supervisor sees a shortage only from the note the weigher signed.
The laboratory receives the sample the weigher prepared, not a generated result.
skills_to_grow: Tell a scale readout from a quantity they are willing to sign.
Refuse a tally that names a worker as the cause of a defect.
role.ambitious_version: A signed quantity can be on the shipping record the same shift, and the weigher still signs it.

job.title: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, and Samplers, Recordkeeping
